_comment: Copy this per device. 'image' is a photo/illustration of the device, straight-on, path relative to this file. 'corners' = screen corners in that image's pixels, clockwise from top-left: TLx,TLy,TRx,TRy,BRx,BRy,BLx,BLy. Find them with: mockup.py IMAGE --grid grid.png, then check with --outline.
